sentences.en: A great light was diffused over the baseball stadium.
sentences.zh: 棒球场上空弥漫着一道强烈的光芒。

sentences.en: The lotus blossoms diffused an inexpressibly pleasant scent.
sentences.zh: 荷花散发出一种难以言喻的香气。

sentences.en: Layla tried to diffuse the situation.
sentences.zh: 莱拉试图缓解当时的局面。

senses.zh: 四散的, 漫射的 - 冗长的, 累赘的 -
(使)扩散, (使)弥漫, (使)传播 - (使)慢慢混合
